evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which demands near-market, high-TRL technologies with short timelines; instead, every selected technology starts at TRL 1 with executability scores of 1.0 and the portfolio is entirely exploratory R&D-stage, directly contradicting the commercialization-focused mandate.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The selected technologies (High-Ni cathode, slurry process, Si-anode, all-solid-state cathode) all fit within the declared Cathode Materials / Functional Materials domain, showing reasonable domain coherence; however, there is no evidence of competitor positioning analysis or differentiation rationale beyond the domain alignment.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대 strategy, completion should be within ±0.5 years of boom; instead, the mean timing error is 2.19 years with all technologies completing significantly after their boom windows — TECH-006 misses by 3.5 years and TECH-003 by 2.5 years — representing systematic and severe post-boom delivery.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: Technologies selected (High-Ni, Si-anode, all-solid-state) are broadly recognized as active patent and market growth areas, suggesting some awareness of convergence zones; however, with executability uniformly scored at 1.0 and all starting at TRL 1, the selection appears to reflect generic trend-following rather than deliberate convergence-zone targeting.
